operating_notes.text: Preferential issue proceeds of ₹166.2 Cr fully utilised by March 31, 2026, with no deviations from objects.
Vasai plant with 1 lakh MT installed capacity commenced operations and CWIP was capitalised in FY26.
Preferential issue of ₹316.77 Cr fully utilised by Q2FY26: ₹31.68 Cr to subsidiaries, ₹146.57 Cr to associates, ₹69.26 Cr working capital and ₹69.26 Cr general corporate purposes, with nil balance.
25 May 2026: NSE fined Tembo Global ₹1,67,560 (incl. 18% GST) for 71 days of non-compliance with Reg. 17(1A) in the quarter ended 31 December 2025; the company paid within the prescribed timeline.
FY26 order book ~₹1,548 Cr with a bidding pipeline of over ₹2,256 Cr and ₹700+ Cr of port construction and fuel farm opportunities being pursued.
Tembo was L1 bidder for a Kuwait offshore revamp project estimated at ~₹300 Cr, covering fire protection, marine equipment and integrated infrastructure.
Debt-to-equity 0.77:1, ROCE 18.4% and ROE 20.0% as of 31 March 2026.
Solar projects: 28 sites total, with 7-8 sites to be commissioned immediately and remaining by end of Q2FY27
Solar project cost: ₹600 Cr, with ₹300 Cr already spent
Defense segment: Small arms manufacturing license obtained on 31 Dec 2025, ammunition license on 19 Apr 2026
Defence manufacturing facility in Amravati, Maharashtra under development with commercial production targeted for Q1 FY2028
Inaugurated new factory unit at Amravati MIDC for manufacturing defence products including arms and ammunition.
Bhoomi Poojan performed on Oct 23, 2026, for the Amravati defence facility under TCEPL.

timeline.summary: On 21 May 2026, NSE granted trading approval for Tembo Global's 30,78,052 preferential shares, admitted to dealings from 22 May 2026 with lock-in to late November 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹345.96 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹26.91 Cr.
On 25 May 2026, Tembo Global's Reg. 32 statement showed the ₹316.77 Cr preferential issue proceeds fully utilised by Q2FY26, with no deviation from the stated objects.

On 25 May 2026, Tembo Global told the exchange its board had reviewed NSE's 27 February 2026 fine of ₹1,67,560 (incl. GST) for not passing a special resolution under Reg. 17(1A) for a non-executive director past 75, and that the fine was paid on time.
On 26 May 2026, Tembo Global's FY26 press release reported revenue of ₹1,090.2 Cr (+46.7% YoY) and PAT of ₹98.2 Cr (+79.7%), an order book of ~₹1,548 Cr, and FY27 revenue guidance of ~₹1,600 Cr.
Tembo Global Industries Limited’s **Sanjay Jashbhai Patel (Managing Director)** schedules earnings call for **June 05, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST** to discuss Q4 & FY2026 results.
Tembo Global raised FY27 revenue guidance to ₹1,600 Cr (+30-40% YoY) and announced defense segment targeting 30-35% PAT margins with 5-10% revenue contribution
Tembo Global Industries lists on BSE main board and announces strategic focus on defence manufacturing including small arms, ammunition and drone technologies
Tembo Global subsidiary Tembo Classic Engineering inaugurated its new defence manufacturing factory in Amravati, Maharashtra.
Tembo Global performed the Bhoomi Poojan for its TCEPL subsidiary's defence manufacturing facility in Amravati, Maharashtra.
Received NSE trading approval for 40,50,000 equity shares issued upon conversion of preferential warrants, effective October 26, 2026.
